text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Kitasan Black asks me to
accompany
her during her dance lesson.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
One and two and, one and two and!
Ooone...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah, darn it. I messed up again!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Yeah. I tend to get a little carried away while dancing...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
And then I end up shouting chants like

"Heave-ho!" and "Hiyah!" like I'm at a
festival or
something!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You don't exactly hear those things at
concerts,
so it'll probably confuse fans if
I shout stuff like
that during an actual
performance...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Sigh... What do people usually do when they get all excited like that?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's a good idea! Let's see... What I
really want
to know is—
choice_data_list: 気になるなら聞いてみたら？
choice_data_list_en: If you're curious, why not ask?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's a good idea! Let's see... What I
really want
to know is—
choice_data_list: かけ声の活かし方を知りたいよな
かけ声の活かし方を知りたいよね
クールになるには、とか？
choice_data_list_en: It'd be good to know how to make the most of those shouts.
It'd be nice to know how to make the most of those shouts, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You think I should try to make use
of them
rather than hold them back?
Hm, how would I do
that?
choice_data_list: かけ声の活かし方を知りたいよな
かけ声の活かし方を知りたいよね
クールになるには、とか？
choice_data_list_en: It'd be good to know how to make the most of those shouts.
It'd be nice to know how to make the most of those shouts, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I've got you! You should just yell before
and after
songs rather than while you're
dancing. ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Even during Umadol concerts, you can
hype up
the crowd by engaging them in
a call and
response routine! ☆

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I can just turn these shouts into a
back-and-forth
with the audience just
like that?! Is that really
okay?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let me show you! ♪ Ready? here
we go! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Heeeave-HO! ☆

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Heeeave-HO!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, amazing! I feel like our hearts
connected,
Falco!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Riiight?! ☆ Connecting with fans is super

important for Umadols! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Kita. ♪ Would you like to
learn more
about being an Umadol? I'll
teach you whatever
you wanna know! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Smart Falcon's advice, Kitasan
Black's
performance range becomes
even more diverse!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You wish to know how to control your
excitement
during concerts?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for the sudden question, Flash! I
was just
amazed at how flawless your
performance was
when I watched your
concert.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I figured you must be really good at
staying
composed and keeping your
emotions under
control.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hm. If that is the advice you seek from
me, then
let me see...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
First, I'd recommend that you reflect on
where
your feelings of excitement stem
from.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You can't hope to solve the problem if
you don't
know the cause. When do you
usually find
yourself becoming excited?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
When people are cheering for me, of
course!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
When I hear people shouting my name,
it makes
me super happy and I just want
to yell back my
thanks to them and—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Your desire to shout is born from your
feelings of
gratitude, so perhaps you can
try conveying that
gratitude in a
different way.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see! I'll try harder to express my
feelings through
my dancing, then!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After learning the truth behind her
emotions,
Kitasan Black's dance skills
become further
refined.
